podcast.body: Public Image Ltd launched their first album in 1978, referred to in the transcript as "Versyshu," generating high expectations as it was Lydon's new band and he was still considered the face of punk by many. However, its design was far from punk, with members posing like a Vogue photoshoot. Its sound also surprised many, as it didn't completely break with punk rock tradition but included tracks with strong dub and dance music influences. "En 1978 lanzaron su primer disco, Versyshu."
